title: serviceContract
responsibility: Projects source-declared service and model methods into shared parameter, return and error contracts.

inputs.name: serviceContract.unit
inputs.description: The viewed service unit, including recorded classes and methods, owned symbols, and declared parameter, return and error fields.

inputs.name: modelContract.unit
inputs.description: The selected model declarations, including static public methods and existing qualified error contracts.

outputs.name: serviceContract
outputs.description: CRUD-first callable signatures with parameter, return and error groups, plus facts outside discovered methods. Multiple classes keep qualified method names; no discovered methods returns empty arrays.

outputs.name: modelContract
outputs.description: Source-declared model methods projected through the service renderer, retaining authored qualified parameter metadata without inventing methods, defaults or requiredness.

errors.name: serviceContract.TypeError
errors.description: BigInt or circular examples cannot be serialized as JSON.

errors.name: serviceContract.RangeError
errors.description: A deeply nested example can exceed the JSON serializer stack.

errors.name: serviceContract.Example serialization callback error
errors.description: A supplied example getter, proxy trap or toJSON method can throw during serialization.

errors.name: modelContract.TypeError
errors.description: BigInt or circular examples cannot be serialized as JSON.

errors.name: modelContract.RangeError
errors.description: A deeply nested example can exceed the JSON serializer stack.

errors.name: modelContract.Example serialization callback error
errors.description: A supplied example getter, proxy trap or toJSON method can throw during serialization.
